title: Pricing a Harbison Protection Contracts Purchase by Scope, Capacity and Channel
content:
**Price by scope and capacity.** The price of a Harbison Protection Contracts purchase depends on scope and capacity:

- a single unit of up to 3.0 nominal tons, or any heating-only unit, takes the tier's single-unit up-to-3-tons price;
- a single unit over 3.0 tons takes the tier's single-unit over-3-tons price;
- a matched system whose outdoor unit is up to 3.0 tons takes the tier's matched-system up-to-3-tons price;
- a matched system whose outdoor unit is over 3.0 tons takes the tier's matched-system over-3-tons price.

Capacity is the nominal tonnage on the equipment register, and exactly 3.0 tons falls in the up-to-3-tons band.

**Price by channel.**

| Channel | Price | Where it is billed |
|---|---|---|
| Bought on the installation contract | the listed price discounted by the tier's installation discount percentage, rounded to the cent half up; the contract records that discounted price | on the installation project, not on the contract |
| Post-installation purchase | the full listed price | on the contract, as a contract-price charge |
| Aftermarket purchase | the full listed price, plus the inspection fee | on the contract, as a contract-price charge and an inspection fee charge |
| The included workmanship warranty | $0.00 | — |
| A contract issued by transfer | $0.00 | — |

**The installation price in words.** The price bought on the installation contract is the listed price for the scope and capacity band, multiplied by one less the installation discount percentage expressed as a fraction, rounded to the cent half up.

**Worked examples (hypothetical equipment, using the listed prices and the 10% installation discount).**

| Equipment | Band | Channel | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3.0-ton air conditioner alone, Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection | single unit, up to 3.0 tons | post-installation | full single-unit up-to-3-tons price |
| 4.0-ton heat pump with matching air handler, Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection ($929.00 listed) | matched system, over 3.0 tons | on the installation contract | $929.00 less 10%, that is $836.10 |
| Gas furnace alone, heating-only | single unit, up to 3.0 tons | aftermarket | full single-unit up-to-3-tons price, plus the inspection fee |
| 3.5-ton outdoor unit with matching coil, Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection ($2289.00 listed) | matched system, over 3.0 tons | on the installation contract | $2289.00 less 10%, that is $2060.10 |
